NETWORK.NAME: HighSuicideClozapine_R4_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest

drafting_lead=BNs/BN-08.xml inference-disabled draft; nodes, states and edges retained verbatim; missing root priors added and deterministic 0-1 workflow tables replaced with soft synthetic placeholders preserving each deterministic argmax

VARIABLE.NAME: SchizophreniaEstablished
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Schizophrenia established (clinician-confirmed)
definition=Clinician-confirmed schizophrenia. No means assessed and not confirmed; not missing diagnostic data
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: SubstantialSuicideRisk
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Substantial suicide risk (clinician judgment, current)

definition=Clinician assesses current risk for suicide attempts or suicide as substantial, with recorded date, ideation/attempt summary, instrument/version and rationale. A C-SSRS severity level alone never satisfies this; No does not mean zero risk
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: SuicideRiskPersistsDespiteOtherTreatments
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Suicide risk persists despite other treatments

definition=Clinician documents substantial suicide-related risk persisting despite other treatments, with treatments, dates, response and adherence evidence reviewed. Not two failed trials and not treatment resistance
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Urgent safety concern (current)
definition=Clinician identifies need for urgent safety assessment or intervention, including acute suicide-related concern or serious suspected treatment harm. Absent does not certify safety
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AdherenceConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Adherence concern
definition=Documented adherence problem or uncertainty about actual exposure needing clinical review; distinct from entirely missing adherence assessment
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ModifiableSuicideRiskTargetsPresent
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Modifiable suicide-risk targets present
definition=Clinician identifies potentially modifiable suicide-risk factors requiring treatment-plan attention; never derived from a checklist or demographics
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineTreatmentStatus
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine treatment status
definition=CurrentTreatment takes precedence if presently receiving clozapine; otherwise past exposure versus never treated. Status only; no dose, duration, route or frequency
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: WillingToDiscussClozapine
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Willing to discuss clozapine
definition=Patient currently willing to discuss clozapine; not consent to treatment
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineMonitoringPlanAvailable
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine monitoring plan available
definition=Feasible clinician-reviewed monitoring and follow-up plan available per current local guidance. No means a documented planning or logistical gap, not an absolute contraindication
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineMedicalReviewCompleted
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine medical review completed
definition=Current clinician or pharmacist benefit-harm, contraindication and interaction review documented. Yes means review performed, not that clozapine is safe or appropriate
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineSuicideRiskIndication
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine suicide-risk indication

definition=Documented schizophrenia plus substantial suicide risk persisting despite other treatments. NotEstablished does not rule out clozapine for other indications; treatment resistance is deliberately not a parent
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: SuicideRiskTreatmentPlanReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Suicide-risk treatment-plan review
definition=Independent review needs; never a prerequisite delaying indicated clozapine discussion or urgent care. NoAdditionalFlag means neither modeled concern flagged, not a complete plan
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineDiscussionPreparation
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine discussion preparation
definition=Address preference concerns, monitoring access or an unfinished medical review. PreparedForDiscussion never means medical clearance or consent
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: SuicideRiskClozapineReviewPathway
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Suicide-risk clozapine review pathway

definition=Proposed workflow with urgent assessment first. Current or prior clozapine branches preserve the separate indication flag and require clinician interpretation; no branch authorizes starting, restarting, continuing or stopping treatment
source=BNs/BN-08.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review
